title: Best Meditation Music Composers (2026): Calm Tracks for Any Use
description: How to hire a meditation music composer for apps, videos, yoga or sleep content: length, loops, licensing, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Meditation music composers create calm, ambient tracks for meditation apps, guided sessions, yoga classes, sleep content and relaxation videos. Good meditation music supports focus without pulling attention, with smooth sound and no jarring changes. Projects go wrong when tracks have sudden sounds, loops are not seamless, or the license does not cover apps or streaming. This guide helps you get music that relaxes listeners and is safe to publish.
